predictions.rationale: Central class representing the Use Case Diagram itself; manages diagram behavior, figures, and interactions.
Graph model that holds the semantic elements (actors, use cases, relationships) shown in a Use Case Diagram.
Responsible for painting/rendering nodes and edges (actors, use cases, associations) on the Use Case Diagram.
Initializes the Use Case Diagram subsystem; registers factories, actions, and settings specific to this diagram type.
UI action that creates or opens a Use Case Diagram, directly invoked from menus/toolbars.
Property panel shown when a Use Case Diagram is selected, allowing users to view/edit its properties.
Factory that creates the property panel for Use Case Diagrams; ties diagram type to its UI configuration.
Model–layer interface or helper representing Use Case Diagrams within the core model; supports persistence and manipulation.
Explorer rule that navigates from a use case to its extension points; supports browsing elements used in Use Case Diagrams.
Unit tests for UMLUseCaseDiagram; while not part of runtime, it directly targets the diagram’s functionality.
